To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have studied analytically the peculiarities in the self action of inclined wave beams incident on a discrete system of optical fibers, and have developed a method that allows one to predict the evolution of localized fields in such a system.
we have developed a new method for studying the self action of optical beams in discrete systems of optical fibers and applied it to the case of radiation incident at an angle.

the self action of inclined quasi optic beams injected into a discrete nonlinear Schrödinger medium consisting of a periodic system of mutually coupled nonlinear optical fibers is accompanied by the self focusing of radiation, the shift of the maximum of the intensity field, and the trapping of radiation by a channel in a nonlinear medium.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the peculiarities of self action of inclined wave beams in discrete nonlinear systems, which are described by the DNSE.
the self action of wave beams incident on a discrete system of optical fibers at an arbitrary angle.
the peculiarities of self action of inclined wave beams in a discrete nonlinear Schrödinger equation (DNLS) framework.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

in a system of optical fibers the radiation self focusing is possible at any angle of incidence of radiation on such a medium, which is accompanied in the case of a critical power by the self trapping of a wave beam in the channels of the array.
the main features of the self action and the self focusing of radiation in a discrete medium are described quite accurately by a simple variational approach based on the DNSE.
the self focusing of wave beams injected at a certain angle into a periodic structure of weakly coupled nonlinear optical fibers is possible.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we found the conditions of the self channeling of wave radiation in a periodic medium of nonlinear optical fibers and the regimes of self channeling in the form of a single channel or a system of two channels.
the developed variational approach allows one to predict the main features of the self action for the beams incident on a periodic array of optical fibers at a small angle to the axis.

the self action of wave beams incident on a system of optical fibers at an arbitrary angle to the axis of the system is determined by the balance between the self action of radiation and the action of a periodic inhomogeneity of the system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the self channeling of radiation in the case of radiation incident at an angle to a periodic system of coupled nonlinear fibers is possible only for radiation powers exceeding a critical value.
the self action of inclined beams in a periodic system of optical fibers is characterized by the formation of a wave field with a complex structure.

the self action of radiation in the discrete medium is determined by the interplay of two main factors: the self action in the medium of the individual fiber and the interaction with the neighboring elements of the system.
